License evidence
The creator's OpenGameArt upload identifies bhu1c as the author and explicitly lists CC0 under License(s), linked to https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/.
This was a single PNG download without a separate license file; preserve this record of the source-page declaration.

Imported and derived files
pipe.png is the original unchanged PNG, renamed from pipe_1.png.
Assets/Art/PipeBody.asset references region x=848, y=0, width=328, height=500 in Unity's bottom-left texture coordinates.
Assets/Art/PipeRim.asset references region x=786, y=525, width=454, height=280.
No original PNG pixels were altered. These Sprite assets select regions of the imported texture. Scene rendering scales the artwork to the existing pipe shapes; the upper rim is flipped vertically. Collision shapes are separate.
